licence.note: DNABERT-2 releases the code, the data and the models at github.com/MAGICS-LAB/DNABERT_2, which is Apache-2.0, so the release the authors point at is the licensed one. Recorded with the qualification that the GUE_2 archive itself is served from the Google Drive file the README links (1uOrwlf07qGQuruXqGXWMpPn8avBoW7T-) and carries no terms of its own. GUE is assembled from public sources - EPDnew, ENCODE ChIP-seq via UCSC, Ensembl GRCh38 and a published yeast histone-mark set. The one GUE task with a redistribution problem of its own is covid_variant_classification, whose sequences come from GISAID EpiCoV, whose access agreement forbids redistribution; it is excluded on task format and so is not published here. Apache-2.0 permits redistribution provided the licence and the attribution notices are kept.
